captureMode.how: Real React SPA from a built dist, served and mocked entirely by Playwright routes on http://huf.mock (scripts/huf/app.mjs); no Frappe backend, no server process, no network.

variableSystem.kind: css-custom-properties (shadcn + HUF design tokens on :root, Tailwind theme reads them)
variableSystem.notes: Light = :root tokens (no attribute); dark = [data-theme="midnight"] (set from the colour-scheme preference in lib/personalization.ts). Tailwind dark: variant is off. The shipped palette (tokens.json) is authoritative; DESIGN.md section 2 describes an earlier orange/paper palette.

tokens.css: tokens/css/huf/<source-slug>/*.css (exact build CSS of each captured branch, chosen per component from the stylesheets the live page loaded) + tokens/css/huf/huf-fonts.css
tokens.fonts: tokens/fonts/ (Inter, Geist Mono; OFL, tokens/fonts/LICENSES.md) + tokens/huf/fonts/ (KaTeX, MIT)
tokens.icons: lucide-react inline SVG, captured in the DOM
